title: Get To Know Me
text:
Research Projects

Does Education Affect Religiosity?
Research Project — World Values Survey Indonesia
This research examines the relationship between educational attainment and religiosity using World Values Survey Indonesia data.
Methods

Data cleaning
Descriptive statistics
Regression analysis
Data visualization
R programming

Tools: R, RStudio, ggplot2, dplyr, flextable



PISA Data Analysis
Educational Research Project
Analysis of PISA data to explore relationships between student experiences, school environment, and educational outcomes.
Methods

Data preparation
Exploratory data analysis
Data visualization
Regression analysis
Multilevel analysis

Tools: R, tidyverse, ggplot2



Asesmen Nasional 2025
Educational Data Analysis
Analysis of Indonesian Asesmen Nasional data focusing on student learning outcomes and constructive feedback.
Tools: R, tidyverse, data.table

wvs7idn <- wvs7 |> 
  select("Q260: Sex", 
         "Q262: Age", 
         "X003R: Age recoded (6 intervals)",

         "Q6: Important in life: Religion",
         "Q164: Importance of God",
         "Q275: Highest educational level: Respondent [ISCED 2011]",
         "Q165: Believe in: God", 
         "Q171: How often do you attend religious services", 
         "Q172: How often do you pray", 
         "Q173: Religious person",
         "Q166: Believe in: life after death",
         "Q167: Believe in: hell",
         "Q168: Believe in: heaven") |> 
  rename(sex = "Q260: Sex", 
         umur = "Q262: Age",
         usia = "X003R: Age recoded (6 intervals)",
         Kelompok_agama = "Q289: Religious denominations - major groups",
         percaya_tuhan = "Q165: Believe in: God",
         Agamapenting = "Q6: Important in life: Religion",
         God_penting = "Q164: Importance of God",
         Pendterakhir = "Q275: Highest educational level: Respondent [ISCED 2011]",
         Kehadiran = "Q171: How often do you attend religious services",
         Tingkat_keagamaan = "Q172: How often do you pray",
         orang_religius = "Q173: Religious person",
         Percaya_tuhan = "Q165: Believe in: God",
         percaya_afterlife = "Q166: Believe in: life after death",
         percaya_neraka = "Q167: Believe in: hell",
         percaya_surga = "Q168: Believe in: heaven")|>
  mutate(Pendterakhir = as.character(Pendterakhir)) |>
  filter(!Pendterakhir %in% c('-1', '0')) |>
  mutate(sex_responden = dplyr::recode(as.character(sex),
                                       '1'= 'Perempuan',
                                       '2'= 'Laki-laki'),
         usia = dplyr::recode(usia,
                           '1' = "18-24",
                           '2' = "25-34",
                           '3' = "35-44",
                           '4' = "45-54", 
                           '5' = "55-64", 
                           '6' = ">65"),
         Agamapenting = dplyr::recode(as.character(Agamapenting),
                                      '1'= '4',
                                      '2'= '3',
                                      '3'= '2',
                                      '4'= '1'),
         Kelompok_agama = dplyr::recode(as.character(Kelompok_agama),
                                        '0'='Tidak ada',
                                        '1'='Katholik roma',
                                        '2'='Protestan',
                                        '3'='Orthodox',
                                        '4'='Yahudi',
                                        '5'='Muslim',
                                        '6'='Hindu',
                                        '7'='Budha',
                                        '8'='Lainnya',
                                        '9'='Kong Hu Cu'),
         Pendterakhir = dplyr::recode(as.character(Pendterakhir),
                               '1'='SD',
                               '2'='SMP',
                               '3'='SMA',
                               '4'='Sarjana',
                               '5'='Sarjana',
                               '6'='Sarjana',
                               '7'='Sarjana',
                               '8'='Sarjana'),
         orang_religius = dplyr::recode(as.character(orang_religius),
                                        '1'='3',
                                        '2'='2',
                                        '3'='1' )) |>
  mutate(Pendterakhir = factor(Pendterakhir,
                           levels = c("SD", "SMP", "SMA", "Sarjana")))
nrow(wvs7idn)

[1] 2888

WVS7IDN <- wvs7idn |>
  filter(!is.na(Pendterakhir), 
         !is.na(Kehadiran), 
         usia !="18-24") |>
  droplevels() |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
  )) |>
   dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting,
      orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ ifelse(.< 0,NA,.)
  ))   |>
mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ (. - min(., na.rm = TRUE)) /
      (max(., na.rm = TRUE) - min(., na.rm = TRUE))    ## distandarisasi 
  )) |>
  mutate(Religiositas = rowMeans(
    across(c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
